summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, and platform-policy boundaries. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private, keep external outreach unsent, authorize no rights-dependent monetization, and continue only bounded read-only evidence, existing repair-or-close, and measurement reconciliation. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access mechanics but not public or commercial reuse rights; public terms point against the proposed data use. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 35 pass, 14 fail, 10 unknown, with open banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings. Security, accuracy/freshness, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed and 4 remain open. No task is closed because current evidence is partial. Open tasks: source rights; alert-data flow and retention; GA4 consent and configuration; logs, vendors, and incident handling. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Do not send outreach, change the private gate, enable tracking, or expand monetization.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required and launch-blocked; user alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed. No data-use item is clear or conditionally launchable on the current evidence.

Retain ordinary growth only conditionally: incomplete telemetry alone is not a blocker, but no retained change may expand data collection, monetization, claims, affiliate use, platform exposure, or regulated/age-sensitive scope without site-specific evidence. Preserve existing deferred SEO and performance opportunities as non-legal backlog only; do not infer revenue, consent, rights, or causal lift from rankings, impressions, technical metrics, or aggregate affiliate activity.

Keep the gated product private and external outreach unsent. Continue only existing read-only rights, privacy, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and security evidence work pending counsel and owner authorization.
